input.title: Website leads review
input.summary: Priya Raman explained that most new work comes from referrals and the website form brings in about two leads a month. The group decided to fix the form routing before spending on ads. No ad spend is planned until form submissions reach the right person.
decisions: Fix the form routing before spending anything on ads.

actionItems.task: Audit where form submissions go and report back
actionItems.quote: I'll audit where the form submissions go today and report back next Tuesday.

actionItems.task: Write up which project types they want more of
actionItems.quote: I will write up which project types we actually want more of.

followUp.subject: Website leads: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Priya and Theo,

Thanks for the time today. We decided to fix the form routing before any ad spend.

I will audit where the form submissions go and report back next Tuesday. Priya, your note on which project types you want more of will shape the routing.

Best,
Jordan
